plan.title: Institutionalization and propagation of value-feedback rules

narratives.Description: Mirror the RFC2119 value-feedback rules across AGENTS.md, the agents-entry template, and the agent-prompt-preamble, and lock them with contract-test markers. Add skill-routing triggers and reconcile the documented-but-unimplemented 4h summary debounce the readback relies on.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
- Add the mirrored rule blocks to the AGENTS.md maintainer file and the content template source, then run agents refresh so the consumer projection inherits them.
- Extend the agents-entry contract test markers and add tests verifying the debounce is implemented rather than only documented.
narratives.UserStory: As a directive maintainer, I want the value-feedback rules mirrored and contract-locked, so that the consumer AGENTS.md inherits them and they cannot silently drift.

narrative.Acceptance: The agents-entry contract test rejects a diff that drops any mirrored value-feedback marker.
Running agents refresh updates the consumer AGENTS.md with the mirrored value-feedback rule blocks.
A test validates the 4h summary debounce suppression window that the readback relies on.

expected_outputs: Mirrored value-feedback rules across AGENTS.md and templates
Contract-test markers plus an implemented summary debounce

references.title: Issue #1709: Epic: Directive value attribution & adoption loop (RFC)
